task: ADR-039 (Shadow-Gate Learning and the Review-Finding Corpus): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Defines a write-once shadow-verdict contract in Episode.metadata (no new record type, ADR-002), base-rate agreement with a Wilson bound declared in the FDD, and a time-ordered protocol for the reconstructed corpus. Human authority is unchanged (ADR-003 Invariant 6). Design only.
Four alternatives named and rejected: train on approval gates only, auto-approve low-risk gates, backfill by re-reading PRs, amend ADR-036 instead.
States the costs: more metadata and one more step per gate review and Step 8, rows needing a human read, and thin gates staying inconclusive.

Marks the methodology table as a preliminary reading not checked against learner code, discloses that the margin and corpus-health thresholds are left to the FDD, that two rows fail the parser, and that every registered approval-gate episode is an approval so gates cannot test discrimination.
